verdict.rationale: Replit's docs say it ships two built-in auth options that Agent provisions automatically, with no separate dashboard signup and no copy-pasting of OAuth keys. That gives builder-scaffolded apps the concept of a user and per-user data, and authentication is marketed as a zero-setup built-in service. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of which login methods are supported (email/password vs. named social providers like Google/GitHub), details of the two auth options, and independent hands-on corroboration of the scaffolded sign-up flow.
